instruction: Patch style rule: smaller_diffs. Good: -3 lines +3 lines. Bad: -10 lines +12 lines with reformatting.
target_output: Apply: -3 lines +3 lines. Avoid: -10 lines +12 lines with reformatting.

instruction: Patch style rule: no_unrelated_changes. Good: Only touch the buggy function. Bad: Fix whitespace, reorder imports, rename variables.
target_output: Apply: Only touch the buggy function. Avoid: Fix whitespace, reorder imports, rename variables.

instruction: Patch style rule: import_hygiene. Good: Don't add imports you don't use. Bad: Add 5 imports, only use 1.
target_output: Apply: Don't add imports you don't use. Avoid: Add 5 imports, only use 1.

instruction: Patch style rule: consistent_formatting. Good: Match project style. Bad: Use different formatting than surrounding code.
target_output: Apply: Match project style. Avoid: Use different formatting than surrounding code.
